methodology: forced GC + Runtime used-heap diff, 3 trials, median; per-step allocation = ThreadMXBean allocated bytes over 20 repetitions of the scenario after 3000 warm-up steps; estimates, not supported capacity
perPlayerRetained: nothing: the simulator is stateless, PhysicsState/PhysicsResult are values the caller owns; the behaviour cache is engine-wide and bounded by the dictionary (65536 states)
